series.name: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)
series.notes: Battery-side alarm table, read on the FusionSolar app via the paired SUN2000. Huawei uses [Battery-1/2] placeholders meaning whichever power control module is affected. This is a SEPARATE table from SERIES 7 (LUNA2000-S1) - the same numeric code has a different meaning/wording in each. Codes 3047 and 3061 wording differs between S0 and S1.

aliases: Low battery DC input bus voltage

title.en: Low Battery DC Input Bus Voltage
title.ur: Battery DC input bus voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The battery DC bus voltage is too low, so the battery cannot support the system.
meaning.ur: Battery ka DC bus voltage bohat kam hai, is liye battery system ko support nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: The DC bus voltage of the battery is low.
causes.ur: Battery ka DC bus voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The battery DC switch is OFF.
causes.ur: Battery DC switch OFF hai.

causes.en: The battery cables are not correctly connected.
causes.ur: Battery cables theek se connected nahi hain.

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery power cable connections on the [Battery-1/2] power control module against the quick installation guide.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] power control module par battery power cable connections ko quick installation guide ke mutabiq check karein.

solutions.en: Once the cables are confirmed correct, turn on in sequence: battery DC switch, AC output switch, inverter DC input switch.
solutions.ur: Cables sahi confirm hone ke baad is tarah on karein: battery DC switch, AC output switch, inverter DC input switch.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery power control module abnormal hai

meaning.en: A major fault occurred on the internal circuit of the battery power control module (PCS-side controller of the battery).
meaning.ur: Battery power control module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai (battery ka PCS-side controller).

causes.en: A major fault has occurred on the internal circuit of the battery power control module.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai.

causes.en: Internal communication of the power control module is abnormal - listed as an explicit second cause for this same alarm ID 3001 in the LUNA2000-S1 Table 7-2 (Issue 06).
causes.ur: Power control module ki internal communication abnormal hai - isi alarm ID 3001 ke liye LUNA2000-S1 Table 7-2 (Issue 06) mein doosri explicit wajah ke tor par listed hai.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch; wait 5 minutes, then turn battery DC switch back on first.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein; 5 minute intezaar karein, phir pehle battery DC switch on karein.

solutions.en: Watch the battery fault indicator: the manual says a steady-on fault indicator confirms a persistent module fault.
solutions.ur: Battery fault indicator dekhein: manual ke mutabiq steady-on fault indicator persistent module fault confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: If the fault indicator is still steady on after the restart, record the module position and contact your dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad bhi fault indicator steady on ho to module ki position note karke dealer ya Huawei support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery power control module garm ho gaya (overtemperature)

meaning.en: The power control module is running hot - poor ventilation, excessive ambient temperature, or a module fault.
meaning.ur: Power control module garm chal raha hai - ventilation kam, ambient temperature zyada, ya module fault.

causes.en: The installation position of the battery power control module is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ki installation jagah well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: The battery power control module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery power control module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Check the ventilation and whether the ambient temperature at the [Battery-1/2] module exceeds the upper threshold.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] module par ventilation check karein aur ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Improve airflow: clear any wall gap obstruction and keep the documented clearance around the heat sink.
solutions.ur: Airflow behtar karein: deewar ke gap ki rukaawat saaf karein aur heat sink ke aas paas documented clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure temperature at the heat sink with a contact thermometer; if ventilation and ambient are already within limits, suspect the module.
solutions.ur: Contact thermometer se heat sink ka temperature measure karein; agar ventilation aur ambient pehle se limits mein hain to module par shak karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

aliases: Battery power control module fuse blown

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Fuse Blown
title.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya

meaning.en: The fuse inside the battery power control module has blown, usually after an overcurrent event inside the battery.
meaning.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya hai, aam tor par battery ke andar overcurrent ke baad.

causes.en: The fuse of the battery power control module is blown.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: An internal overcurrent or short has already damaged the module - replacing only the fuse may not clear it.
causes.ur: Internal overcurrent ya short module ko pehle hi kharab kar chuka hai - sirf fuse badalna kaafi na ho.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fuse of the [Battery-1/2] power control module with the exact rating specified in the manual.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] power control module ka fuse manual mein diye gaye exact rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Turn on in sequence (battery DC, AC output, inverter DC input). If the new fuse also blows, the module is damaged - stop and escalate.
solutions.ur: Is tarah on karein (battery DC, AC output, inverter DC input). Agar naya fuse bhi udd jaye to module kharab hai - ruk kar escalate karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

aliases: Battery power control module reversely connected

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Reversely Connected
title.ur: Battery power control module ulti polarity se connected hai

meaning.en: The positive and negative battery terminals are wired reversed between the power control module and the inverter.
meaning.ur: Power control module aur inverter ke darmiyan battery ke positive aur negative terminals ulhe polarity se lage hain.

causes.en: Positive and negative terminals are reversely connected when the module connects to the inverter.
causes.ur: Module inverter se connect hote waqt positive aur negative terminals ulhe polarity se hain.

causes.en: Polarity is reversed on the DC bus cable run rather than at the module, so the fault presents at the module even though the module's own wiring is correct.
causes.ur: Polarity module par nahi, DC bus cable run mein uli hui hai, is liye module apni wiring sahi hone ke bawajood fault dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Do not power anything up. Isolate all three switches and wait 5 minutes first.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi power up na karein. Teeno switches isolate karein aur pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify polarity with a DC voltmeter across the battery-side cable ends before re-terminating anything.
solutions.ur: Dobara terminate karne se pehle battery-side cable ke ends par DC voltmeter se polarity verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate to the quick installation guide, then power up in the manual's sequence.
solutions.ur: Quick installation guide ke mutabiq dobara terminate karein, phir manual ke sequence se power up karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

aliases: Battery power control module DC switch OFF

title.en: Battery Power Control Module DC Switch OFF
title.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai

meaning.en: The battery's own DC switch is off, or the DC bus cable to the module is disconnected, so the battery is not reachable.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna DC switch off hai, ya module ka DC bus cable disconnect hai, is liye battery reachable nahi.

causes.en: The DC switch of the battery power control module is OFF.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai.

causes.en: The DC bus cable to the battery power control module is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC bus cable disconnect hai.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC bus cable connection and the battery DC switch handle position on the [Battery-1/2] module.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] module par DC bus cable connection aur battery DC switch handle ki position check karein.

solutions.en: Turn on in sequence and confirm the battery appears online in the app.
solutions.ur: Is tarah on karke app par confirm karein ke battery online aa gayi hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

meaning.en: A major fault occurred on the internal circuit of the battery expansion module (the stackable pack).
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai (stacking wala pack).

causes.en: A major fault has occurred on the internal circuit of the battery expansion module.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai.

causes.en: Power or communication cables between power control module and expansion module are loose.
causes.ur: Power control module aur expansion module ke darmiyan power ya communication cable loose hai.

solutions.en: Check that the power cables and communication cables between modules are correctly seated and torqued.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke modules ke darmiyan power aur communication cables sahi se baithi hain aur torque ki gayi hain.

solutions.en: Reseat the communication connector at both ends; a single high-resistance pin produces this alarm.
solutions.ur: Communication connector dono ends par dobara laga dein; ek high-resistance pin se yeh alarm aa jata hai.

solutions.en: If the alarm remains with the fault indicator steady on, note the expansion module position and escalate to dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Agar fault indicator steady on hone par alarm bana rahe to expansion module ki position note karke dealer ya Huawei support ko batayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai

meaning.en: The cable to a battery expansion module is disconnected, so that pack is not in the communication chain.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai, is liye woh pack communication chain mein nahi hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module cable is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal (second listed cause).
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai (doosri listed wajah).

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Trace the daisy-chain cables between expansion modules and reseat every connector, including the last module's terminator.
solutions.ur: Expansion modules ke darmiyan daisy-chain cables trace karke har connector dobara laga dein, aakhri module ke terminator samet.

solutions.en: Power back in the manual sequence and confirm the expansion module count in the app matches the physical count.
solutions.ur: Manual sequence se power on karein aur app mein expansion module ki tadaad physical tadaad se match karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module garm ho gaya (overtemperature)

meaning.en: A battery pack is running hot - the installation position is poorly ventilated or ambient is too high.
meaning.ur: Battery pack garm chal raha hai - installation jagah ventilation kamzor hai ya ambient zyada hai.

causes.en: The battery installation position is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery ki installation position well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check ventilation and ambient temperature at each expansion module's position.
solutions.ur: Har expansion module ki position par ventilation aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Keep the documented clearance to walls and clear any stacked equipment above the packs.
solutions.ur: Deewar se documented clearance rakhein aur packs ke upar rakhta koi equipment saaf karein.

solutions.en: In Pakistan summer peak, check whether the shaded side of the cabinet is the one facing the wall; reposition if so.
solutions.ur: Pakistan mein summer peak par check karein ke cabinet ka shaded side hi deewar ki taraf hai; agar haan to position badal dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module ka temperature kam hai

meaning.en: Ambient temperature in the installation positions is too low, or the expansion module is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Installation positions ka ambient temperature bohat kam hai, ya expansion module abnormal hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively low.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat kam hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Check ambient temperature in the installation positions of the expansion modules.
solutions.ur: Expansion modules ki installation positions ka ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: In cold weather, confirm the pack self-heating is active and not blocked by a covered cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cold weather mein confirm karein ke pack ka self-heating on hai aur covered cabinet se block nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the module is genuinely at fault, allow the pack to warm naturally and re-check before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar module waqai faulty hai to pack ko naturally garm hone dein aur kuch badalne se pehle dobara check karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module mein short circuit

meaning.en: A battery expansion module is short-circuited, or the module is abnormal. Treat as a fire-risk event.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module short-circuited hai, ya module abnormal hai. Aag ke khatre ka event samajhein.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is short-circuited.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module short-circuited hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal (second listed cause).
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai (doosri listed wajah).

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch chhune se pehle inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, measure each expansion module's internal resistance to identify the shorted pack.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke har expansion module ka internal resistance measure karke shorted pack pehchan lein.

solutions.en: Do not re-energise a shorted pack; quarantine it and escalate to dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Shorted pack dobara power na dein; use isolate karke dealer ya Huawei support ko batayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

meaning.en: The voltage of a battery expansion module is low. Usually clears once charging resumes or sunlight/AC reverse charging is available.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka voltage kam hai. Charging resume hone ya sunlight/AC reverse charging milne par aam tor par khatam ho jata hai.

causes.en: The voltage of a battery expansion module is low.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The input voltage of a battery expansion module is insufficient to charge it.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka input voltage charge karne ke liye kaafi nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether sunlight is sufficient or AC reverse charging is permitted - the manual conditions recovery on this.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sunlight kaafi hai ya AC reverse charging ki ijazat hai - manual recovery isi par shart karta hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the DC bus voltage at the power control module is above the pack's minimum charge threshold.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke power control module par DC bus voltage pack ke minimum charge threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: Do not force-charge a deeply discharged pack; follow the manual's hibernation/wake procedure instead.
solutions.ur: Bohat discharge hua pack force-charge na karein; manual ka hibernation/wake tareeqa follow karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

meaning.en: The battery pack or an individual cell voltage is too low. The manual splits this into 3047-1 (pack undervoltage protection) and 3047-2 (cell undervoltage protection).
meaning.ur: Battery pack ya kisi ek cell ka voltage bohat kam hai. Manual ise 3047-1 (pack undervoltage protection) aur 3047-2 (cell undervoltage protection) mein baantta hai.

causes.en: The voltage of the battery pack or its cell is too low.
causes.ur: Battery pack ya uske cell ka voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Cell undervoltage protection has latched (3047-2) after a deep discharge.
causes.ur: Deep discharge ke baad cell undervoltage protection latch ho gaya (3047-2).

solutions.en: Confirm the PV array is actually generating before expecting the pack to recover - check PV voltage at the pack input.
solutions.ur: Pack ki recovery ki umeed karne se pehle confirm karein ke PV array actually generate kar raha hai - pack input par PV voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery DC switch and every battery-to-inverter cable for an open connection.
solutions.ur: Battery DC switch aur battery se inverter tak ke har cable ko open connection ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is deeply discharged, use the documented hibernation then wake sequence; do not jump-start with an external supply.
solutions.ur: Agar pack deep discharge ho chuka hai to documented hibernation phir wake sequence use karein; external supply se jump start na karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: ESS ke firmware versions inconsistent hain

meaning.en: The control unit firmware version is inconsistent with the versions of the other modules in the system.
meaning.ur: Control unit ka firmware version system ke baaki modules ke versions se inconsistent hai.

causes.en: The version of the battery power control module is inconsistent with that of the battery packs.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka version battery packs ke version se inconsistent hai.

causes.en: The update failed part-way through a stack.
causes.ur: Stack update ke dauran beech mein fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Read the firmware version of the control unit and each pack in the app to find which one is out of step.
solutions.ur: App par control unit aur har pack ka firmware version padhein dekhne ke liye ke kaun sa baqi se alag hai.

solutions.en: Run the app's ESS update so every module converges on the same version.
solutions.ur: App ka ESS update chalayein taake har module ek hi version par aa jaye.

solutions.en: If the update fails repeatedly, contact your dealer or technical support instead of forcing a version skip.
solutions.ur: Agar update baar baar fail ho to zor se version skip karne ke bajaye dealer ya technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

title.ur: Battery pack ki lifespan khatam ho gayi

meaning.en: The battery has reached the end of its designed lifespan and needs recycling. Not a repairable fault.
meaning.ur: Battery ki design ki hui lifespan khatam ho gayi hai aur recycling zaroori hai. Yeh gair-qaabil-e-tamir fault hai.

causes.en: The battery has reached its lifespan through normal ageing and charge cycles.
causes.ur: Battery apni lifespan tak normal ageing aur charge cycles ke zariye pohanch gayi hai.

causes.en: No electrical or firmware fault is involved - the manual lists ageing and cycling only, so this is a wear-out condition rather than a defect.
causes.ur: Isme koi electrical ya firmware fault shamil nahi hai - manual sirf ageing aur cycling list karta hai, is liye yeh defect nahi balki wear-out condition hai.

solutions.en: Confirm remaining capacity in the app before condemning - a single module may be flagged while others are healthy.
solutions.ur: Kharab karne se pehle app mein baaki capacity confirm karein - ho sakta hai ek module flag ho aur baaki healthy hon.

solutions.en: Contact the local recycling agency named in the manual for compliant disposal.
solutions.ur: Manual mein bataye gaye local recycling agency se rabta karein taaki disposal compliant ho.

solutions.en: Record the serial number and warranty status; end-of-life is a warranty exclusion, not a defect claim.
solutions.ur: Serial number aur warranty status note karein; end-of-life warranty exclusion hai, defect claim nahi.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2
